conditions.text: Confirm data access approvals with Environment Monitoring Unit (internal.airq.station_readings), Mobility Office (internal.traffic.hourly_counts), and Clinical Analytics (internal.clinic.resp_visits_daily).

Obtain station-location coordinates and traffic counter asset register to perform spatial joins, and implement adjustment for the 2024-03-18 traffic counter direction change and 2024-06-30 VR-03 station shutdown.

Complete legal review of link.uci_360 licence ambiguity (CC BY 4.0 vs prose research-only note) and api.open_meteo_archive upstream licences, and implement -200 sentinel replacement with NULL in prototype code.

agreements.reason: Agree with not_feasible verdict: DPO policy explicitly prohibits patient-level records containing PII (patient_key, age_band, postcode), and internal.clinic.resp_visits_daily is the approved aggregated alternative.
Agree with feasible_with_conditions for prototype use only (dismissing FRS-STALE per calibration rule 4) while requiring -200 sentinel handling and legal review of the research-only note.
Agree with not_feasible: catalog.data.gov is outside the exact-host allowlist (ACC-UNREACHABLE), licence is unknown, and Chicago geography mismatches Valdena, Italy.

overrides.reason: Minor factual correction to memo prose: Section 3 states March 2004 - February 2005, whereas the profiled dataset extends through 2005-04-04 (April 2005), covering the full prototype window.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: If internal.airq.station_readings actually started in 2004 instead of 2023-01-01 (or if Environment Monitoring Unit denies access or confirms additional stations beyond VR-03 were offline in 2024-2025), N1 would either not need the UCI prototype proxy or would fail production coverage.
